title: D8298-41

page_data.en:
D.C. (Sp. Branch)
S.R. 298/41
Date 2 / 11 / 38

"B"
Misc.No. 445/38. Bubbling Well
1st. November 38.

1.

HAND GRENADE EXPLODED AT NO.121 YOONG NYOEN
PANG, OFF BUBBLING WELL ROAD, P.S.B., YOONG
NYOEN CLUB(永源娛樂社), ABOUT 9 P.M. OCT.,
31ST 1938, INJURING 8 PERSONS ASSEMBLED FOR
GAMBLING.

At 9.38 p.m. Oct. 31, 1938 a telephone report was
received from the J.C.R. stating that the S.F. Brigade
ambulance had been called to B'well Road near Tifeng Rd
Enquiries disclosed that at about 9 p.m. Oct. 31,
1938 a hand grenade had exploded at No.121 Yoong Nyoen
Pang(永源浜) off B'well Road, P.S.B., Yoong Nyoen Club,
where some 300 Chinese had assembled for gambling. The
club is situated about 100 yards off B'well Rd, O.O.L.
Fragments of the bomb injured 7 male Chinese and
a female, names as follows:-

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 813 2.11.38）

(1) Tseu Yao Jing(周耀琴).
(2) Zung Yu Ming (陳友明).
(3) Sung Tsing Ying(沈俊英).
(4) Zee Kya Fac(徐嘉宝), female.
(5) Tsang Kung Sung(張根生).
(6) Ting Teoong Poo(丁忠甫).
(7) Zee Ah Nyi(徐阿二).
(8) Chu Ching Vung(朱敬文).

All were suffering from lacerations about the legs
and arms, and are expected to recover from their
injuries. Nos. 4, 5, 7 & 8 are still detained.

副总监（特别处）
S.R. 298/41
日期：38年11月2日

“B”
杂项编号 445/38。静安寺
1938年11月1日。

1.

手榴弹在静安寺路旁永源浜121号永源娱乐社爆炸，时间为1938年10月31日晚9时许，致使聚集赌博的8人受伤。

1938年10月31日晚9时38分，接到中区捕房电话报告，称圣方济各救伤队救护车已被召往静安寺路近提篮桥路处。经查询得知，1938年10月31日晚9时许，一枚手榴弹在静安寺路旁、越界筑路区永源浜121号永源娱乐社爆炸，当时约有300名华人在此聚集赌博。该俱乐部位于静安寺路外侧约100码处。炸弹碎片致7名男性华人和1名女性受伤，名单如下：-

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特别处 813 38.11.2）

(1) 周耀琴 (Tseu Yao Jing)。
(2) 陈友明 (Zung Yu Ming)。
(3) 沈俊英 (Sung Tsing Ying)。
(4) 徐嘉宝 (Zee Kya Fac)，女。
(5) 张根生 (Tsang Kung Sung)。
(6) 丁忠甫 (Ting Teoong Poo)。
(7) 徐阿二 (Zee Ah Nyi)。
(8) 朱敬文 (Chu Ching Vung)。

所有人腿部及手臂均有割伤，预计伤势可痊愈。第4、5、7及8号伤者仍被留置。

page_data.en:
Misc.no.445/38(BW)

1 (Sheet 2)

Red Cross, Paulun and St. Luke's Hospitals.

The Ta Tao Police arrested two suspects named Tah
Zung Ling(秦仁林), age 25, lift operator, native of
Shanghai, residing near the gambling club, and In Dah
Pung(意大车), age 37, Hupeh, residing at No.17 Great
Western Road, employed at the Country Hospital. These
two men are still detained at No.92 Jessfield Road,
pending further investigations by the Ta Tao Police.

Annamite Police Constable No.378 Kah Ying(卡英),
age 33, French Police, was also taken into custody at
the club following the explosion and released from No.
92 Jessfield Road at 4.30 a.m. Nov. 1, 1938, on orders
of the Officer i/c., Western Branch, Japanese Military
Police, as result of an earlier request made by D.S.
Yankovsky, French Police.

The case is being investigated by Mr. Kitaoka,
Japanese Adviser of the Ta Tao Police, who stated to
D.S. Sugimoto that in his opinion the grenade was
fastened with a piece of string about 5 ft. in length
and placed in a position in the club premises near No.
3 gambling table where a gambler tripped over the
string causing the grenade to explode on the floor.

During the confusion a sum of $300.00 was stolen
from the gambling table.

Enquiries by D.S.I. Tilton, D.S.I. Wu Chen Me
and J.D.S. Sugimoto.

Copy to

D.C.(Sp.Branch).

Sen.Det.i/c.

page_data.zh:
杂项编号 445/38(BW)

1（第2页）

红十字会、宏恩医院及同仁医院。

大道警察逮捕了两名嫌疑人，分别为秦仁林 (Tah Zung Ling)，25岁，电梯操作员，上海籍，居住在赌博俱乐部附近；以及意大车 (In Dah Pung)（音译），37岁，湖北籍，居住在大西路17号，受雇于乡村医院。这两人目前仍被关押在极司菲尔路92号，等待大道警察进一步调查。

安南籍巡捕第378号卡英 (Kah Ying)，33岁，法租界巡捕，也在爆炸发生后于俱乐部内被拘留，并于1938年11月1日凌晨4时30分奉日本宪兵队西区负责人之命，从极司菲尔路92号获释，此举系应法租界侦探长扬科夫斯基 (Yankovsky) 早先提出的请求。

此案正由大道警察日本顾问北冈 (Kitaoka) 先生调查，他向侦探长杉本 (Sugimoto) 表示，他认为手榴弹系在一根长约5英尺的绳子上，并放置在俱乐部场所内靠近第3号赌桌的位置，一名赌徒被绳子绊倒，导致手榴弹在地板上爆炸。

在混乱中，赌桌上被盗走300.00元。

由副总督察蒂尔顿 (Tilton)、副总督察吴振美 (Wu Chen Me) 及日本侦探长杉本 (Sugimoto) 进行查询。

抄送
副总监（各分区）
副总监（特别处）。

高级警探主管

备忘录。“B”分区。
